abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one FitFlow instance is supported.

unused_muscle_group.title: Muscle group is not used by any workout
unused_muscle_group.description: The muscle group "{muscle_group}" is not linked to any workout. Add it to a workout or remove it if it is no longer needed.

empty_muscle_group.title: Muscle group has no exercises
empty_muscle_group.description: The muscle group "{muscle_group}" has no exercises. Add at least one exercise to make it useful in workouts.

duplicate_exercise_name.title: Duplicate exercise name
duplicate_exercise_name.description: There are {count} exercises named "{exercise_name}". Rename or remove duplicates to keep workout selection unambiguous.
